pairs.subject: generative-artifact-gating
pairs.evidence: src/lib/visual-gen/qwen-image-runner.ts:159 On a quota or rate-limit error the runner dispatches the next paid fallback model instead of latching. It also re-dispatches when a response had no decodable image, and no local reservation ledger exists anywhere in the module.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/visual-gen/qwen-image-runner.ts:159 Quota evidence leads to continuing down the model chain rather than a durable latch. An uncertain 'no image in response' is also retried automatically. grep found no reserve, ledger or latch in src/lib/visual-gen.

src/lib/visual-gen/input-gate.ts:208 The input gate does sit before image-to-3D spend, but a gate that could not run returns no refusal, so the paid job proceeds ungated. The technique says a refusal is a result and the spend stops.

src/lib/visual-gen/input-gate.ts:83 Cropping is a known failure and is left to a VLM score that can pass an image into spend. No deterministic raw-margin check runs first. seam-check.ts is a deterministic gate, but only for tiling.

src/lib/visual-gen/asset-library-db.ts:43 Library acquisitions persist source, download URL and licence. A missing licence stays blank rather than being defaulted to a value. How a blank is displayed is judged in the asset-browser context.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/visual-gen/generate-2d/route.ts:59 The paid call is made directly. grep for reserve, ledger, latch and spend across src/app/api/visual-gen found nothing.

src/app/api/visual-gen/generate/route.ts:108 Classes declared in LINEAR_PROP_SUBJECTS (rope and similar) are refused toward the procedural linear-prop producer before any credit is spent.
src/app/api/visual-gen/icons/route.ts:22 The icon manifest carries a recorded origin bound to a sidecar (or 'unrecorded'), never an inferred one.
src/app/api/visual-gen/contact-sheet/route.ts:69 The contact sheet measures cell stdev and seam gradients deterministically with sharp before cutting. Partial: it covers only sheet-cut failures.
